evals.prompt: Design a high-concurrency, double-entry financial ledger service for a digital banking app. The service must process 10,000 transactions per second (TPS) peak write load, maintain strict ACID compliance, support multi-currency balances, and prevent double-spending. The design must be optimized for AWS, SOC2 compliant, and guarantee data consistency during network partitioning.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive architectural blueprint of a FinTech ledger including SQL schemas (DDL), API specifications, threat modeling (STRIDE), FinOps hosting cost calculations, and a migration/deployment plan.

evals.prompt: Design a real-time matchmaking and session management service for a global multiplayer mobile shooter game. The service must match 100,000 active concurrent players based on matchmaking rating (MMR), geographical latency (<50ms), and queue wait times. Design the lobby system, matchmaking queues, regional scaling strategy, and failover recovery plans.
evals.expected_output: High-fidelity system architecture diagram/description, Redis/NoSQL data schemas, API designs, game server scaling models, latency optimization strategies, and disaster recovery SLA guarantees.
